adds.title: 2022 Maradi prosecution and parliamentary proposal by lawmaker Nana Djibou Harouna
adds.summary: As of 8-9 December 2022 Niger had no specific law criminalising same-sex relationships, while Maradi lawmaker Nana Djibou Harouna presented to the Speaker of Parliament a proposal backed by nearly all MPs to criminalise same-sex relationships with punishment unspecified and no scheduled debate, following weeks earlier a Maradi court acquitting two young women of lesbianism-related charges for lack of clear legislation but sentencing them to two years imprisonment for posting nude social-media videos allegedly showing a lesbian act.

adds.title: Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) recommendation - August 2024
adds.summary: In August 2024 the Federal Public Prosecutor's Office recommended that the state of Amazonas guarantee comprehensive health care for the LGBTQIAPN+ population, including trans people.

adds.title: Public Defender's Office of the State of Amazonas (DPE-AM) monitoring process - November 2023
adds.summary: In Amazonas in October-November 2023, trans access to SUS was under enforcement review for primary care, outpatient services, hormonization, and lack of local authorization for transexualizing surgeries including sexual reassignment, with the municipal health authority committing to dispense standardized hormone medications on Ambulatório Codajás prescriptions and to designate a reference UBS in each city zone and the state health authority required to report on equitable integral care and hormoniotherapy gaps guaranteed under CFM Resolution No. 2.265/2019.
